summary: gs-rest-service GC settings: druntime's default (conservative) against parallel:1 and parallel:1 minPoolSize:4 incPoolSize:0, same binary, no Go, 4 trials
why: Rewritten per the coordinator's 22:10Z decision, relayed by data-access 22:15Z: one claimed window, three Flint arms of the same binary (druntime's default; parallel:1, which cut the pause about 25% locally with 31 scan threads on a 2-CPU pin; parallel:1 with minPoolSize:4 incPoolSize:0), no Go (--no-go, b520e07a: certified Flint/Go ratios come from the gs-rest-multicore entries), 4 trials per arm (about 27 minutes). Winner rule: the lowest p99 and RSS with no throughput or CPU loss beyond its interval, against conservative; proof-harness computes each arm/conservative ratio of medians with a bootstrap 99% interval from the raw series (wide at 4 trials). Boot then bakes the winner into rt_options. Pinned at b520e07a7ff4 with gs-rest-multicore-5. The record is mode "ab" and never counts as the Phase 1 GC matrix.
